items.source: The Restarter should be initialized early to ensure that classes are loaded multiple times. Mostly the RestartApplicationListener can be relied upon to perform initialization, however, you may need to call initialize(String[]) directly if your SpringApplication arguments are not identical to your main method arguments.
items.translation: Restarter 应尽早 初始化，以确保类被多次加载。通常情况下，可以依赖 RestartApplicationListener 来执行初始化操作；但是，如果您的 SpringApplication 参数与主方法参数不一致，您可能需要直接调用 initialize(String[])。

items.source:
By default, applications running in an IDE (i.e. those not packaged as "uber jars")
will automatically detect URLs that can change. It's also possible to manually
configure URLs or class file updates for remote restart scenarios.
items.translation: 默认情况下，在 IDE 中运行的应用程序（即未打包为"uber jar"的应用程序）将自动检测可更改的 URL。此外，还可以手动配置远程重启场景中的 URL 或类文件更新。

items.source: Initialize restart support for the current application. Called automatically by RestartApplicationListener but can also be called directly if main application arguments are not the same as those passed to the SpringApplication.
items.translation: 初始化当前应用程序的重启支持。由 RestartApplicationListener 自动调用，但如果主应用程序参数与传递给 SpringApplication 的参数不同，也可以直接调用。
